project_context.description: Premium D2C pet food brand in Brazil. Fun, energetic, personal, high-quality, trustworthy.
project_context.benchmark: The Hungry Dog (quality & storytelling, not copy)
project_context.tone: Human, relaxed, striking, non-clinical. D2C premium + editorial + advertising.
project_context.tech_stack: Static React (.jsx/.js), Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Spline (for 3D)

headings.tracking: tracking-tight or tracking-tighter for large sizes

colors.strategy: Warm, earthy bases with vibrant, energetic accents. No clinical navy or supermarket yellow.

borders_and_radius.images: rounded-[2rem] or organic asymmetrical blob shapes (e.g., rounded-tr-[4rem] rounded-bl-[4rem])
borders_and_radius.borders: 1px solid var(--border), slightly darker on hover

shadows.hard_brutalist: shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(26,25,24,1)] (use selectively for badges or specific bold CTAs)

decorations.noise: Subtle SVG grain overlay (opacity-20) on primary colored sections
decorations.stickers: Hand-drawn SVG arrows, underlines, and circular 'selos' (badges) rotated slightly (e.g., rotate-12)

layout_and_spacing.grid: Bento-style grids, overlapping elements, wide gaps (gap-8, gap-12). Avoid rigid Bootstrap 12-col symmetry.
layout_and_spacing.spacing: Generous. Use py-24 or py-32 for sections. Elements need breathing room.
layout_and_spacing.mobile_first: Ensure all grids collapse to 1 column gracefully. Font sizes should use fluid typography or Tailwind clamp utilities.

3d_strategy.hero: Use Spline React component for a floating 3D premium dog treat or bowl to immediately grab attention.
3d_strategy.product_cards: Use Framer Motion to create a 3D tilt effect on hover (`useMotionValue`, `useTransform`).

micro_interactions.buttons: Scale down slightly on tap (scale: 0.98), hover arrow translates right.
micro_interactions.marquees: react-fast-marquee. Editorial style, slow and smooth.
micro_interactions.reveals: Framer motion `whileInView` staggered reveals (y: 30, opacity: 0) for section content.

components_instructions.shadcn: Install Shadcn components as .jsx/.js (no TypeScript). Use standard Vite + React setup.
components_instructions.side_cart: Use Shadcn Sheet component for the drawer. Show placeholder items. CTA inside goes to WhatsApp link.
components_instructions.icons: Use lucide-react or @phosphor-icons/react. Add data-testid to ALL interactive elements.
components_instructions.forms: Use simple client-side state for the static Newsletter demonstration. Do not send or persist personal data.

universal_guidelines.rule_1: You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific transitions (transition-colors, transition-transform).
universal_guidelines.rule_2: Do NOT center align the app container. No '.App { text-align: center; }'.
universal_guidelines.rule_3: Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for elements that overlay content (like sticky headers or dropdowns). Use a solid color or heavy backdrop-blur with a semi-transparent color.
universal_guidelines.rule_4: Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
universal_guidelines.rule_5: Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, button scales, entrance animations.
universal_guidelines.rule_6: All interactive elements MUST have `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid="hero-cta-button"`).
universal_guidelines.rule_7: Convert all components to .js / .jsx, since this is not a TypeScript project.
